thread.title: Barclays: 16M iPhone sales ‘at risk’ in light of $29 battery replacement program

author: Anon
title: Barclays: 16M iPhone sales ‘at risk’ in light of $29 battery replacement program
text:
Home » Barclays: 16M iPhone sales ‘at risk’ in light of $29 battery replacement program Barclays: 16M iPhone sales ‘at risk’ in light of $29 battery replacement program 3 January 2018 Anon 
Barclays has shared a new analyst note today covering its predictions for how the battery replacement program will influence AAPL performance. Among its forecasts, the note shares the possibility of 16M iPhone sales being lost. Keep up to date with LMR Apple Support
